maddeler.e:
ابتذلوا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَذَلُوا (ibtaḏalū) /ib.ta.ða.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# اُبْتُذِلُوا (ubtuḏilū) /ub.tu.ði.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# اِبْتَذِلُوا (ibtaḏilū) /ib.ta.ði.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
